examples.vi: Tôi cần hút bụi tấm thảm trước khi khách đến.

examples.en: He was vacuuming the stairs when the doorbell rang.
examples.vi: Anh ấy đang hút bụi cầu thang thì chuông cửa reo.

senses.vi: hút bụi; dọn bằng máy hút bụi

idioms.gloss: Generating and maintaining a near-vacuum is challenging (requiring technical rigor) because ambient pressure tends to push matter forcefully into the evacuated chamber; and generating a true vacuum (devoid of any matter at all) is extremely challenging.
To pack something in an airtight container from which some or all of the air is removed, creating a partial vacuum.
Divorced from its proper context and therefore suffering from incomplete analysis.

tatoeba.en: Nothing can exceed the speed of light in a vacuum.
tatoeba.vi: Không gì có thể vượt qua tốc độ ánh sáng trong chân không.
